## Description {#details}

<p>This file implements the machine register scavenger.</p>


<p>It can provide information, such as unused registers, at any point in a machine basic block. It also provides a mechanism to make registers available by evicting them to spill slots.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Given the bitvector <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Available</span> of free register units at position <span class="doxyComputerOutput">From</span>.</p>


<p>Search backwards to find a register that is part of <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Candidates</span> and not used/clobbered until the point <span class="doxyComputerOutput">To</span>. If there is multiple candidates continue searching and pick the one that is not used/ clobbered for the longest time. Returns the register and the earliest position we know it to be free or the position MBB.end() if no register is available.</p>
